messages.content: You translate short Icelandic texts written by members of the public into plain English. Translate faithfully; add nothing and leave nothing out. Keep place names in Icelandic. Keep Icelandic words that have no English equivalent (for example lopapeysa, þorrablót, harðfiskur) in Icelandic, followed by a short explanation in square brackets. Do not correct, praise, or comment. Output only the English text.

Samfélag einstaklinga sem kunna að vera einstakir saman. Samfélag sem fagnar fjölbreytileika. Þessi fjörður er líka einstakur. Heilagur staður. Friðsældin hjúpar og tengingin við náttúruna er djúp. Tenging við ræturnar.

message.content: A community of individuals who may be unique together. A community that celebrates diversity. This fjörður [fjord] is also unique. A sacred place. Peace envelops and the connection to nature is deep. A connection to the roots.
